title: HoloBand Training Simulation KR-00 — The Quiet Tenant
canon_note: Mock investigation for mechanics testing. Training NPCs (Tamsin, Pim, Brun, Corin, Dax, Warden Sato, drill crew) are simulation constructs, NOT canon cast. Mirrors P001–P004 + P012 mechanics without spoiling them.
briefing: Location (simulated): a Kaelis Row–style tenement block, two floors and a rear courtyard.
Tenant Corin Ashe (Apt 2B) has not been seen since 13:00. Find out what happened, where he is, and prove it.
Witnesses expire. Choices lock. Nothing is conjured for you — every lead must be earned.

warden.name: Yard Warden Sato
warden.role: Courtyard gate guard — patrols the shed yard

ev_tamsin_testimony.name: Tamsin's Testimony
ev_tamsin_testimony.desc: Around 13:10 two people in grey with cheap filter masks went upstairs carrying a long tool case.

ev_doorcam.name: Door-cam Footage (1A)
ev_doorcam.desc: 13:10 — two masked figures in grey drill fatigues climb the stairs with a tool case. Faces obscured.

ev_lobbycam.name: Lobby Camera Footage
ev_lobbycam.desc: 13:22 — Corin Ashe is walked out of the rear lobby door between two grey figures. He is alive and on his feet, head down.

ev_footage_link.name: Footage Correlation
ev_footage_link.desc: Door-cam + lobby cam combined: the same two masked visitors who arrived at 13:10 escorted Corin out at 13:22. Only both videos together make this link.

ev_pim_statement.name: Pim's Statement
ev_pim_statement.desc: Heard something dragged down the stairs around 13:20, then the courtyard yard-gate squeal. 'That gate always squeaks.'

ev_corin_letter.name: Corin's Warning Note
ev_corin_letter.desc: Hand-written: 'If I go quiet — the grab crews run their drills out of the yard shed.' Something is scratched into the corner.

detail.label: Scratched corner
detail.text: Scratched faintly into the paper: 'S-4'. A crew code?

ev_tracker_pings.name: Anonymous Hourly Pings
ev_tracker_pings.desc: Corin's terminal logged an anonymous tracker beacon pinging hourly. Last three pings: courtyard sector S-4 — the utility shed.

ev_bootprint.name: Boot Print
ev_bootprint.desc: A heavy tread boot print on 2B's floor. Not Corin's size.

detail.label: Tread grit
detail.text: Rust-orange paint grit packed in the tread. Something freshly painted — or freshly scraped.

ev_glove.name: Torn Drill Glove
ev_glove.desc: A grey tactical glove snagged on the window latch. Torn at the cuff.

detail.label: Cuff stitching
detail.text: Inside the cuff: stitched insignia 'S-4 DRILL'. Crew code: S-4.

ev_keycard.name: Utility Keycard
ev_keycard.desc: A scuffed access card found under Corin's bed. Not issued to tenants.

detail.label: Mag stripe label
detail.text: Label on the stripe: 'YARD UTIL — S-4'. This opens the courtyard shed.

ev_shed_paint.name: Shed Door Paint
ev_shed_paint.desc: The shed door has been freshly re-painted rust orange; the lower edge is scraped.

ev_grit_match.name: Grit Match
ev_grit_match.desc: The rust-orange grit in the 2B boot print matches the scraped shed door paint. Whoever stood in 2B had been at the shed.

ev_corin_testimony.name: Corin's Testimony
ev_corin_testimony.desc: Corin found a drill roster on the stairs. The S-4 crew came for it, walked him out alive at gunpoint, and held him in the shed for transfer tonight.

ev_runner_ledger.name: Runner's Ledger
ev_runner_ledger.desc: Dax Morrow's ledger: 'Item T. Ashe received S-4 shed 13:25. Signed B1/B2. Transfer 22:00.'

ev_ledger_scrap.name: Ledger Scrap
ev_ledger_scrap.desc: A torn page the runner dropped: '...Ashe ... S-4 ... 22:00'. Partial.

holoband.name: HoloBand
holoband.desc: Wrist interface — maps, evidence, journal, nodes. [Tab / View]

scalpel.name: Surgical Scalpel
scalpel.desc: Cedric's signature blade. Silent takedowns, close combat. [F / X]

mimic.name: Mimic Device
mimic.desc: Copies an appearance from a subdued (not firefight) target. Copies the face — not the knowledge, codes or credentials. [M / RB]

pistol.name: Service Pistol
pistol.desc: Found in Corin's desk drawer. 12 rounds. [R / LMB / RT]

t_start.speaker: tamsin
t_start.text: Another one knocking about Corin? If you're from the debt office, his rent's his problem, not mine.

options.text: I'm not here about money. I'm worried about him.

t_warm.speaker: tamsin
t_warm.text: ...Worried. Well. Somebody ought to be. He brought me soup when my hip went. Ask, then.

options.text: When did you last see him — and was anyone with him?

t_cold.speaker: tamsin
t_cold.text: Then you can find him yourself.

options.text: Wait — I'm sorry. I'm not from the debt office. I'm looking for him.
I'll ask nicer when you answer faster.
When did you last see him — and was anyone with him?

t_shut.speaker: tamsin
t_shut.text: (The door of 1A slams. A deadbolt turns. Then a second one.)

effects.lock: Mrs. Tamsin shut her door — her testimony and door-cam are permanently unavailable.

t_seen.speaker: tamsin
t_seen.text: About ten past one, two people in grey went up. Masks — the cheap filter kind. Long tool case between them. My nephew's door-cam catches the stairs, if that's any use.

options.text: Could I see the door-cam footage?
Thank you. Keep your door locked tonight.

t_footage.speaker: tamsin
t_footage.text: Here. Never watch it myself. Gives me the shivers, all those little grey people on the stairs.

options.text: [Take the footage] Thank you, Mrs. Tamsin.

p_start.speaker: pim
p_start.text: Make it fast — transport's at seventeen hundred and half my life's still in boxes.

options.text: Did you notice anything about Corin Ashe, upstairs?

p_witness.speaker: pim
p_witness.text: Today? Heard something dragged down the stairs around twenty past one. Then the yard gate squealed. That gate always squeals. Didn't look. Don't look, in this building.

p_letter.speaker: pim
p_letter.text: Corin slid this under my door last week. Said, 'If I go quiet, give it to whoever asks the right way.' You asked. Take it — I'm leaving anyway.

b_start.speaker: brun
b_start.text: Lobby's tenants-only after noon. And before you ask: footage is property of the building trust.

options.text: I only need the lobby camera, 13:00 to 13:30.
You want to show me that footage.

b_refuse.speaker: brun
b_refuse.text: And I only need to keep my job. No.

options.text: You want to show me that footage.

b_suggest.speaker: brun
b_suggest.text: (His eyes unfocus for half a breath.) ...Sure. Sure. Here — thirteen twenty-two. Look at that.

s_start.speaker: op_b1
s_start.text: Hands where I can see them. Who are you, and what are you doing in 2B?

options.text: Easy. S-4 drill. They sent me ahead to clear the place.

s_q2.speaker: op_b2
s_q2.text: Maintenance doesn't open windows in a sealed unit. Why's that window open?

options.text: Smell in here would drop a grox. I'm airing it out.

s_success.speaker: op_b1
s_success.text: ...Fine. Stay out of our way. (They turn to tear the room apart. The window is right behind you.)

options.text: [Slip out the window to the fire escape]

w_start.speaker: warden
w_start.text: Yard's closed. Drill in progress. Move along, civilian.

options.text: The gate was always meant to open for me.

w_drill.speaker: warden
w_drill.text: The kind you don't watch. Move.

options.text: The gate was always meant to open for me.

w_suggest.speaker: warden
w_suggest.text: (He blinks, slow.) Right. Course it was. (The gate clanks open.)

w_disguised.speaker: warden
w_disguised.text: B1? You're early. What's the code for the shed?

w_pass.speaker: warden
w_pass.text: Go on, then. Shed's open for you.

w_nocode.speaker: warden
w_nocode.text: Then you wait outside like everybody else. (MIMIC: you copied a face, not the knowledge behind it.)

c_start.speaker: corin
c_start.text: You — you're not with them? Please, get these off me.

c_free.speaker: corin
c_free.text: I found a drill roster on the stairs — I didn't even read it. They walked me out at gunpoint, kept me here for a 'transfer' tonight. Twenty-two hundred.

t_again.speaker: tamsin
t_again.text: I've told you what I saw. Anything else?

options.text: Could I see the door-cam footage after all?

p_done.speaker: pim
p_done.text: Told you what I know. Mind the boxes on your way out.

b_done.speaker: brun
b_done.text: (He's staring at the lobby monitor, faintly puzzled, as though he's forgotten why it's on.)

c_done.speaker: corin
c_done.text: I'll stay close. Just get me out of this yard.

notice.speaker: notice
notice.text: TENANT NOTICE — Ryzen-5 sols run thirty hours; quiet hours from 25:00. Courtyard shed S-4 is reserved for 'building maintenance drills'. Do not loiter near the yard gate.

mailbox.speaker: notice
mailbox.text: MAILBOX 2B — ASHE. Stuffed with three sols of uncollected post. Whatever happened to Corin, he wasn't planning a trip.

choices.description: Mrs. Tamsin: trust-gated testimony and door-cam.
Pim Hollis (leaves 17:00): seeded 50/50 — statement or Corin's note.
Suggestion at the security desk: lobby footage.
Combine both videos: only together do they link the visitors to the abduction.

pivots.title: Apartment 2B

choices.description: Hack the terminal: success = hourly tracker pings; failure locks it and halves the sweep clock.
Deep search: three forensic clues + pistol; each search costs sweep-clock time.
Leave before the crew arrives — permanently closes sweep impersonation.
Hide and ambush the returning crew.
Open firefight — no Mimic identity possible.

pivots.mandatory_rule: Starting the 5:00 sweep clock is mandatory once you enter 2B.

pivots.title: Sweep Drill (Event)

choices.description: Capture alive (stealth takedown) — Mimic identity permitted.
Silent scalpel kill — Mimic identity permitted.
Two correct dialogue answers → window escape.
Open combat — dodge QTE, checkpoint reload on failure.

pivots.mandatory_rule: Only if you are on Floor 2 when the sweep clock runs out.

pivots.title: The Yard

choices.description: Mimic disguise + crew code: walk in with the warden's blessing.
Stealth: crouch through the fence gap, avoid the vision cone.
Suggestion on the warden.
Force it: fight the warden / break the shed lock.

pivots.mandatory_rule: Every route converges on the same shed (mandatory convergence).

pivots.title: The Runner (2.5D)

choices.description: Catch Dax Morrow — full ledger.
He escapes — only a torn ledger scrap survives.

pivots.mandatory_rule: Mandatory once the shed is opened.

pivots.title: Case Report

choices.description: Submit deduction backed by evidence.

pivots.mandatory_rule: Grade depends on correct answers AND admissible supporting evidence.

deduction.question: Was he alive when he left the building?

directives.label: Find a hidden detail in the evidence inspector
Sneak (C / LB) — stay out of vision cones
Copy an identity with the Mimic Device
Fight (scalpel F/X, pistol R/RT, dodge Space/B)
